key_expressions: Can you make it less sweet?,
Can I get this to go?,

A: Hi, what’s the most popular drink here?
Oh, a sweet flavor sounds nice! Is it very sweet?
Great, I’ll have that drink.
B: Hi! Our vanilla latte is the most popular.
No, it’s gently sweet.
Alright, I’ll make one vanilla latte for you!

A: Can you make it less sweet?
Oh, you can put only half the syrup?
Then please add just a little syrup.
B: Yes, we can adjust the sweetness.
Sure, I can add only half.
Alright, I’ll make it lightly sweet.

A: Can you put less ice in the iced drink?
Oh, great! I don’t want it too cold.
Okay, please add just a little ice.
B: Yes, we can change the amount of ice.
Yes, with less ice it feels smoother.
Sure, I’ll add just a little ice!

A: How long does it take for the drink to come out?
Oh, that’s faster than I expected!
Okay, I’ll wait a bit.
B: Since it’s being made now, about three minutes.
Yes, it’ll be ready soon.
I’ll call you when it’s done.

A: Do you have a signature menu?
Oh, I like rich flavors! Is it strong?
Great, I’ll order one.
B: Yes! Our signature is the condensed-milk latte.
It’s rich but still smooth.
Alright, I’ll prepare one for you.

A: What does today’s coffee taste like?
Oh, the acidity isn’t too strong, right?
Great, I’ll take today’s coffee.
B: Today we’re using mild Brazilian beans.
Yes, it’s quite smooth.
Alright, I’ll brew one right away!

A: Can I get this packed to go?
Oh, it doesn’t take long to pack?
Okay, please pack it for me.
B: Yes, we can pack it.
No, it only takes one or two minutes.
Sure, I’ll pack it right away!

A: Can I order a sandwich too?
Oh, can you heat it up?
Great, please warm it up for me.
B: Yes, we have several sandwiches.
Yes, I can heat it if you want.
Alright, I’ll warm it up for you!

A: How do I pay here?
Oh nice, you take mobile payment too!
Okay, I’ll pay by card.
B: We take card and cash.
Yes, mobile payment works as well.
Sure, please hand me your card.

A: Can I get this in a takeout cup?
Oh, hot drinks can be takeout too?
Great, please give it to me in a takeout cup.
B: Yes, I can put it in a takeout cup.
Yes, hot drinks are also available for takeout.
Alright, I’ll prepare it in a takeout cup!
